# Fetch all recommendations (paginated)
page_limit=20

    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

    page_index+=1

        break

# Filter: genre == 'R&B' and release_date year in {current_year, last_year}
filtered=[]
for rec in all_recs:
    sid=rec['song_id']
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=sd.get('genre')
    release_date=sd.get('release_date')
    # Parse year from ISO datetime string
    year=None
    if release_date:
        try:
            year=datetime.fromisoformat(release_date).year
        except Exception:
            # fallback: take first 4 chars
            try:
                year=int(str(release_date)[:4])
            except Exception:
                year=None
    if genre=='R&B' and year in (current_year, last_year):
        filtered.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': sd.get('title'),
            'album_title': sd.get('album_title'),
            'artist_names': [a.get('name') for a in (sd.get('artists') or [])],
            'genre': genre,
            'release_date': release_date,
            'release_year': year,
        })

# Sort deterministically by release_year then title
filtered_sorted=sorted(filtered, key=lambda x:(x['release_year'] or 0, x['title'] or ''))
print('current_year', current_year, 'last_year', last_year)
print('total_recs', len(all_recs))
print('filtered_count', len(filtered_sorted))
for item in filtered_sorted:
    print(item['release_year'], item['song_id'], item['title'], '-', item['album_title'], '| artists:', ', '.join(item['artist_names']))

from datetime import datetime

# 1) Login to Spotify
pw=None
for row in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if row.get('account_name')=='spotify':
        pw=row.get('password')
        break
username='timothy.whit@gmail.com'
spotify_token=apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=pw)['access_token']

# 2) Filter result from prior recommendation check (R&B, released in current/last year)
#    Using discovered song_ids directly to avoid re-fetching all song details.
#    current_year/last_year used: 2023 and 2022.
song_ids_to_add=[176, 11, 182, 10, 297]

# 3) Create new playlist titled exactly requested
create_res=apis.spotify.create_playlist(title='Spotify R&B Recommendations', access_token=spotify_token, is_public=False)
print('create_playlist_res', create_res)

playlist_id=None
if isinstance(create_res, dict) and 'playlist_id' in create_res:
    playlist_id=create_res.get('playlist_id')
elif isinstance(create_res, dict) and 'message' in create_res:
    playlist_id=None

# 4) If create failed, fall back to using existing playlist with that exact title (most recently created)
if playlist_id is None:
    matches=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='Spotify R&B Recommendations', is_public=None, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
        if not page:
            break
        for pl in page:
            if pl.get('title')=='Spotify R&B Recommendations':
                matches.append(pl)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    # sort by created_at desc (string ISO)
    def parse_dt(s):
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return datetime.min
    matches_sorted=sorted(matches, key=lambda x: parse_dt(x.get('created_at')) , reverse=True)
    print('existing_playlist_matches', [(m.get('playlist_id'), m.get('created_at')) for m in matches_sorted])
    if not matches_sorted:
        raise RuntimeError('Could not create playlist and no existing playlist with the requested title was found.')
    playlist_id=matches_sorted[0].get('playlist_id')

print('using_playlist_id', playlist_id)

# 5) Check existing songs in playlist to avoid duplicates
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
existing_song_ids=set([s.get('id') for s in (pl.get('songs') or [])])
print('existing_song_ids_count', len(existing_song_ids))

missing=[sid for sid in song_ids_to_add if sid not in existing_song_ids]
print('missing_song_ids', missing)

# 6) Add missing songs
for sid in missing:
    res=apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('add_song_to_playlist', sid, res)

print('done')
